title: EXIM Domain-Context Synthetic Evidence-Gating Scenarios
source_note: Domain-grounded, expert-authored synthetic cases. These are not real shipment records, customer documents, customs records, or observed production incidents. Every scenario includes an explicit evaluation_mechanism; domain datasets are contextual synthetic cases and do not claim execution of domain-specific policy logic.
